fields.name: Conversion_replacement
fields.description: {"value":"oil/gas options include: conversion - converts the steam turbine of an existing plant to burn gas. replacement - existing plant is retired and replaced with a new gas-fired plant. change of plans - cases in which one or more units were planned and those plans were cancelled and subsequently gas units were planned at the same location. use of ST in CC set - cases where there is a steam turbine (usually coal) and is then repurposed to be part of a gas-fired combined cycle unit. Can also be referred to as “repowering” into a combined cycle where gas turbine(s) and HSRGs are added to the existing steam turbine. Was labeled as \"partial conversion\" in previous GOGPT data releases not found bioenergy options include: gas to bioenergy conversion - when a unit has been or will be converted from gas to bioenergy coal to bioenergy conversion - when a unit has been or will be converted from coal to bioenergy oil to bioenergy conversion - when a unit has been or will be converted from fossil oil to bioenergy no conversion - unit is not associated with a conversion","fieldValueType":"description"}
